headline: Brazil Federal Police indict former BRB head and 13 others over R$ 12.2 billion fraud
summary: Brazil's Federal Police indicted businessman Daniel Vorcaro and the former president of Banco de Brasília alongside 13 others. Investigations revealed unbacked credit transactions totaling R$ 12.2 billion.
why: Large-scale banking fraud investigations impact governance standards, state bank oversight, and financial stability perceptions in Brazil.
